title: Three Indians rescued from attacked cargo ship in Black sea depart for India
summary_full: Amidst a distressing attack on the Turkish-owned MV Royad Mammadov cargo vessel in the Black Sea, three Indian nationals were successfully rescued. After receiving medical care in Romania, they were declared stable. The Indian embassy played a crucial role in ensuring their safe return and provided necessary supplies during their ordeal. Unfortunately, the attack also led to the loss of two foreign seafarers' lives, underscoring the gravity of maritime risks.
